purpose: Teach: 乗り入れ/交わさ/晒し/臆病/上等/物凄い/隅々/善良

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新バスがお店前に乗り入れされるそうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they're saying a new bus route is going to stop right in front of the shop.
lines.style: Warm observation with a hint of quiet excitement. Lift slightly on the news. Pacing is conversational, almost thinking aloud. Gentle, inviting Aoi to see the possibility too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様と挨拶を交わさないわけにはいかないね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We'll need to make sure we greet every customer who comes in, won't we?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Gentle directive, not bossy. A rhythm of acknowledgment—she's thinking through the practical side. Soft emphasis on "greet" like it matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前に新メニューを晒して告知しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's put a new menu board out front—make sure people see what we're offering.
lines.style: Decisive but collaborative. Forward energy. The "let's" carries genuine partnership, not command. Light tempo, organized. Like she's already picturing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人スタッフが臆病だから優しく接しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new staff member's feeling a bit nervous—let's be gentle with them, yeah?
lines.style: Soft, observant. Notes the unspoken worry without drama. A beat of tenderness. Spoken like shared understanding between two people who notice these things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、上等のコーヒー豆を仕入れようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should stock some really good coffee beans—the kind that'll make people come back.
lines.style: Thoughtful, quality-focused. Speaks like quality matters to her personally. Unhurried. A note of quiet pride in what they can offer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、物凄い行列を作ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers are forming quite a line out there—looks like it's working.
lines.style: Pleased but grounded. A note of quiet satisfaction, not self-congratulation. Observant tone. Pacing is calm, the news itself carries the warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の隅々まで磨こうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure every corner of the shop is clean—people notice those details.
lines.style: Practical directive with care underneath. Steady pacing. Not fussy, but thorough. Speaks like care-in-detail is a form of respect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、善良なお客様に感謝しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're lucky to have such good people coming through the door. Let's make sure they know we're grateful.
lines.style: Tender close, genuinely reflective. Slower pace on this one. Warm but not sentimental. A moment of real gratitude, spoken like she means it deeply. Soft landing.
